name: Fake FPS & CPS Counter
description: Shows FPS and CPS counters on screen in every scene. The numbers are fake and come only from the mod settings - they never change the real game FPS or real clicks.

fake-fps.name: Fake FPS
fake-fps.description: What the FPS counter shows. A number (0-100000) or any text/letters you want.

fps-wobble.name: FPS wobble (+/-)
fps-wobble.description: The FPS number moves randomly up or down by up to this much so it looks real. Only applies to numbers.

fake-cps.name: Fake CPS
fake-cps.description: What the CPS counter shows. A number (0-1000) or any text/letters you want.

cps-wobble.name: CPS wobble (+/-)
cps-wobble.description: The CPS number moves randomly up or down by up to this much so it looks real. Only applies to numbers.

fps-image.name: FPS image
fps-image.description: Optional picture (png/jpg) shown next to the FPS number. Leave empty to show the text 'FPS' instead.

cps-image.name: CPS image
cps-image.description: Optional picture (png/jpg) shown next to the CPS number. Leave empty to show the text 'CPS' instead.

pos-x.name: X position %
pos-x.description: Horizontal position of the counters, as a percent of the screen width (0 = left).

pos-y.name: Y position %
pos-y.description: Vertical position of the counters, as a percent of the screen height (100 = top).
